Class TrustManagerFactory

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory
public final class TrustManagerFactory extends Object
The board-side javax.net.ssl.TrustManagerFactory: turns a KeyStore of trusted certificates into the TrustManager an SSLContext takes. Initialised with null, it trusts the board's own roots.
